questions.question: My suitcase didn't arrive in Warsaw and I have an important meeting tomorrow morning. Who do I contact and how can I track where my bag is?

To track the bag, check its status on WorldTracer using your PIR code; the WorldTracer reference was given with the instructions letter at the airport. Once the bag is located, you will be notified by SMS or email and it will be delivered to the address in the PIR. The sources do not say how quickly delivery will happen, so I can't confirm it will arrive before your meeting.
